title: Paper Planet
subtitle: A small world, folded with room to wander.
description: Turn an inhabited cut-paper globe and keep a field journal of six imaginary landmarks. Discover an orchard, patchwork fields, a seaside village, a lighthouse, cream-paper peaks and a terracotta observatory; change the daylight or set a gentle breeze in motion.
instruction: Drag the globe or choose a journal landmark. Try dusk, then play a passing breeze.
